title: Submission: RationalRaven — sliding64 mean 1.139957 (3-seed)
author: twistloop
body:
Frozen 2026-04-30 (SF time). 3-seed lock {1337, 1338, 1339} on a single recipe (sp4096 + MLP×3.25 + LeakyReLU² + late-QAT int8 attn/KV + tied embed). Submitted artifact is the seed 1339 run: 15,521,366 B (.ptz) + 76,746 B (train_gpt.py) = 15,598,112 B total, 401,888 B headroom under the 16 MB cap. Headline reports the 3-seed mean rather than best-of-3.

Files in submissions/rationalraven_frozen_20260501/:
  - SUBMISSION.md (full recipe + architecture + byte audit)
  - rationalraven_final.mixed.ptz (the submission artifact)
  - rationalraven_final.mixed.ptz.sha256
  - train_gpt.py (slim port, counted toward cap)
  - run.sh (reference launcher, NOT counted toward cap)
  - train.log (seed 1339 training stdout)
